facts.text: Macaulay Honors College students at the College of Staten Island receive a four-year full tuition scholarship if they are New York State residents.

sources.title: Admissions | Macaulay Honors College - College of Staten Island
sources.quote: The Macaulay Honors College four-year, financial aid package includes: Full tuition scholarship for New York State residents.

facts.text: The College of Staten Island requires first-year New York State residents to live on campus unless they reside in the five boroughs of New York City.

sources.title: Student Housing Information - College of Staten Island - CUNY
sources.quote: This residency requirement applies to: * first-year New York State resident students, except those residing in the five boroughs of New York City.
